newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Noble Group buys certain Phibro coal assets.
newsitem.headline: HK's Noble Group buys certain Phibro coal assets.

text.p: Steel products supplier and bulk cargo carrier Noble Group Ltd said on Monday it had bought certain Coal and Coke assets from Phibro Inc, a subsidiary of Salomon Inc, for an undisclosed figure, and engaged the services of key Coal and Coke employees.
Noble Group, which delisted from the Hong Kong stock exchange on May 23, said the move would complement its position as one of Asia's major steel companies.

"This is an extremely exciting and logical development for our ever expanding business, particularly in Asia," Noble Group chairman Richard Elman said in a statement. "Additionally, this will give the Noble Group the opportunity to enter into the rapidly growing coal-fired energy market."
In October, Noble hired three commercial fertilizer experts from Phibro.
Salomon said in October its Phibro unit was ceasing its coal, coke and fertilizer trading operations under a plan to reduce headcount.
